note: Short redirect links for LINE and other posts: www.eaglish.store/go/<slug>/?c=<where>. The page adds the tracking codes and sends people on. Add a link here, run `npm run build:go`, open a PR. Hand-made pages under /go/ (like sanfu-farm) are not touched. Links with status closed or unknown (a group buy that is not open) do not redirect: the page says so, offers the calendar and the article, and shows notify only when the config has a real notification link.
